Market today: Tech and AI are driving positive sentiment, especially in cybersecurity, with strong earnings from CrowdStrike and Salesforce. This is good for your concentrated tech/chip book.

Your holdings: SOXL (-54.18%) and SPAL (-40.36%) are bleeding heavily due to their leveraged nature and decay, amplified by your margin use. CRWD (+5.18%) is showing strength today, despite its "TRIM" status.

Watch: Keep a close eye on your leveraged ETFs (SOXL, SPAL) for further decay. Monitor CRWD's momentum after its strong earnings.

Bottom line: Manage your leveraged losses aggressively while riding the positive AI tailwinds in your core tech names.
plays: CRWD: Re-evaluate your "TRIM" status given the strong earnings and AI tailwind; consider holding or adjusting your stop higher.
SOXL / SPAL: Your leveraged ETFs are down significantly. Given the decay and margin risk, consider cutting losses or setting tighter, hard stops to protect capital.
No new buys today - hold and watch.
